question: Can the already-audited parameterized mechanism carrier be installed into the shipped kernel and promoted through the audited product promotion path with a binding pre-freeze positive/negative certificate - src/spider/kernel.py gains a distill_parameterized -> resolve -> execute -> verify/UNKNOWN path whose confidence flow is not defeated by the current literal distill() candidate confidence 0.5 versus default execution threshold 0.8; the frozen experiment demonstrates one known-positive executable binding (an unseen-identifier parameterized mechanism executes) and one known-negative refusal (a binding the carrier cannot safely resolve returns UNKNOWN rather than a wrong execution), records the honest counters and the pinned git blob / sha256 of the shipped version for the later four-arm benchmark, and triggers promotion only on independent audit PASS - thereby discharging blocker B1?
hypothesis: The audited parameterized mechanism carrier (git blob b15ed848, sha256 718efa6a167c2fdc483a8fbaaf1a05ce018dcb1c52808414b2a6a76d788bfb72) can be integrated into the shipped kernel at src/spider/kernel.py such that distill_parameterized is available, resolution uses parameter_slots/support predicates correctly, literal distill() (confidence 0.5) remains below min_confidence (0.8) preserving separation, and the kernel produces one known-positive executable binding on unseen identifiers and one known-negative refusal returning UNKNOWN with bound_action null. The integration preserves existing kernel behavior and passes the promotion-path gate with independent audit PASS.
falsifier: Any of: (1) distill_parameterized not present/importable in src/spider/kernel.py; (2) known-positive test case does not produce ResolutionStatus.EXECUTABLE with correct bound_action; (3) known-negative test case produces EXECUTABLE or a wrong execution (bound_action not null when unsafe); (4) literal distill() candidate causes false EXECUTABLE (confidence threshold defeated); (5) kernel integration breaks existing basic behavior (tests/test_kernel.py regression); (6) cannot pin and record the shipped kernel identity (blob/sha256) for downstream benchmark; (7) promotion gate fails independent audit.

baselines.description: Literal distill() only behavior - mechanism with confidence 0.5 must NOT be executable under min_confidence 0.8
No applicable mechanisms - resolution must return UNKNOWN

null_control.description: Binding that carrier cannot safely resolve must return UNKNOWN rather than wrong execution

measurement_validity: Integration targets only src/spider/kernel.py within Product lane allowed scope
Preserve existing kernel separation: literal distill() confidence 0.5 < min_confidence 0.8
No outcome-bearing measurement during DESIGN; cheap pre-freeze satisfiability probes allowed
Known-negative must test unsafe binding (out of support / missing params / wrong intent) and return UNKNOWN with bound_action null
Kernel identity (git blob sha256/path) pinned and recorded for downstream four-arm benchmark

decision_rule.C2_KNOWN_POSITIVE_EXECUTABLE: Known-positive test yields ResolutionStatus.EXECUTABLE with correct bound_action and verified postconditions
decision_rule.C3_KNOWN_NEGATIVE_UNKNOWN: Known-negative test yields ResolutionStatus.UNKNOWN with bound_action == null (no wrong execution)
decision_rule.C4_LITERAL_BELOW_THRESHOLD: Literal distill() candidate confidence 0.5 < min_confidence 0.8 prevents EXECUTABLE; ablation confirms separation
decision_rule.C5_REGRESSION_FREE: Existing tests/test_kernel.py still pass; no behavior regression
decision_rule.C6_IDENTITY_PINNED: Kernel identity recorded: path, git blob/sha256, file hash pinned for downstream use
decision_rule.C7_ACCOUNTING_HONEST: Counters recorded honestly (model_calls/model_tokens == 0 for this credential-free test path; retrieval_calls counted correctly)

product_consequence_positive: B1 discharged: shipped kernel now has parameterized mechanism carrier with verified liveness (known-positive) and verified abstention (known-negative). Carrier identity pinned for four-arm benchmark. Promotion authorized only after independent audit PASS.
product_consequence_negative: B1 not discharged; parameterized carrier remains experimental code not in shipped kernel. Do not proceed to four-arm benchmark using shipped kernel path until C1-C7 all PASS and audit PASS.
estimated_cost: Low: in-process unit tests, no external network, no model calls, trivial runtime (< 10 seconds).
expected_information_gain: High: Enables the entire downstream benchmark chain (B1 prerequisite). Establishes both liveness and correct abstention (UNKNOWN over wrong execution) - critical for product safety.

freeze_eligibility.freeze_artifacts_bound_reason: No mutable local code/data/task-bank/fixture dependencies outside the kernel code path being tested that can change interpretation; kernel source is the artifact under test and will be part of the shipped state - but design contract v2 requires listing if mutable; the only mutable artifact relevant to interpretation is src/spider/kernel.py itself which is the treatment target. However, we list it as freeze artifact to bind its identity.
